name: rakun-manual
description: Monorepo for Rakun, a TypeScript toolkit for content, routing, manager UI, and web integrations.

scripts.clean: rm -rf core/dist trpc/dist express/dist next/dist s3/dist manager-react/dist
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build --workspace @rakun-kit/core && npm run build --workspace @rakun-kit/trpc && npm run build --workspace @rakun-kit/manager-react && npm run build --workspace @rakun-kit/express && npm run build --workspace @rakun-kit/next && npm run build --workspace @rakun-kit/s3
scripts.build:esm: npm run build:esm --workspace @rakun-kit/core && npm run build:esm --workspace @rakun-kit/trpc && npm run build:esm --workspace @rakun-kit/express && npm run build:esm --workspace @rakun-kit/manager-react && npm run build:esm --workspace @rakun-kit/next && npm run build:esm --workspace @rakun-kit/s3
scripts.build:cjs: npm run build:cjs --workspace @rakun-kit/core && npm run build:cjs --workspace @rakun-kit/trpc && npm run build:cjs --workspace @rakun-kit/express && npm run build:cjs --workspace @rakun-kit/manager-react && npm run build:cjs --workspace @rakun-kit/next && npm run build:cjs --workspace @rakun-kit/s3
